thread:
rachel: Heads-up: we need a concise "launch commitments" checklist for GA next month. Focus: SLA text, public pricing exposure, support cadence, observability retention, and a short AE playbook. Who can pick which?
ben: I'll take SLA wording and rollback criteria. Proposal: 99.9% for standard paid, 99.5% for freemium, with credits scoped to request-level failures only. Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate > 3% for 10m OR p95 latency > 700ms for 15m. Need legal review on credit wording.
sophia: I'll own docs + AE playbook. Deliverables: (1) quickstart updates for Node/Python, (2) migration note for tokenization changes, (3) one-page AE cheat sheet with canned responses for top 8 customer questions. ETA: Wed AM.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled smoke run 2024-04-12T08:00Z - synthetic 120rps for 20m. Alerts will post to #launch-run. Auto-rollback preconfigured: error_threshold: 0.04, window: 600s.
ben: Also adding a short technical SLA appendix explaining per-route SLOs (generation vs embedding), how model-fallbacks affect availability accounting, and the maintenance windows language. Want to include a sample incident credit calc.
rachel: Support ask: 72h high-coverage (12h shifts with overlap) first three days, then hand off to standard oncall. Sophia, please include support escalation flow in AE playbook.
sophia: Will do. I'll include an internal-only troubleshooting checklist: tokenization mismatch, KV cache warmup, quantized fallback quality checks, and how to read the "model-variance" metric.
ben: Observability: retention for traces 21d, logs 30d for launch window. Also need a short-term increase of metric scrape frequency to 30s for the first 72h. Any infra cost concerns?
rachel: FinOps flagged potential cost spike on trace retention. Suggest we enable extended retention only for the launch project ID and add budget alert at $X/day. Sophia coordinate with FinOps for wording on pricing page.
sophia: On pricing: we expose RU bands for each tier (Hobby/Team/Enterprise) + a dedicated reserved contract section. Recommend not exposing microsecond latency guarantees; keep it honesty-forward: typical p95 numbers and a note about variance under high concurrency.
infra-bot: incident-bot: prelaunch runbook dry-run scheduled 2024-04-10T16:00Z. Participants: @oncall, @eng-sre, @product.
ben: Risk list I'm tracking: silent regressions (run eval-suite preflight), burst billing (budget caps + autoscale guardrails), and API contract drift (prevent by SDK quickstart). Mitigations: automated eval on canary, fallback to quantized-small model, and rate-limit/quotas on new customers.
rachel: Comms: We'll need a short public FAQ and an internal "what to say" section for CS. Sophia, can you add a short migration path note for Dedicated/private customers who manage their own models?
sophia: Yep. Also adding a short troubleshooting snippet for on-prem customers re: KMS/HSM keys rotation and private network routing.
ben: I'll post the SLA PR by EOD today with the appendix. Please review + tag legal.
sophia: I'll stage docs in /docs/launch/ and share a link when ready. Also prepping a short training call for AEs next Tue.
rachel: Confirm owners by EOD Friday. If no objections we lock the launch page and start the staged email to pilot customers.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: note - if any canary fails, system will automatically reduce ingress to 30% and switch to model-small-quantized for new sessions.
sales-bot: sales-notify: prepping one-pager for AE + price-sheet. Will need final RU numbers from FinOps by Thu.
rachel: Thanks. Final checklist summary: Ben -> SLA + rollback PR; Sophia -> docs + AE playbook + SDK updates; Infra -> retention + smoke tests; Sales/FinOps -> RU numbers + pricing copy. Everyone ack?
ben: Ack.
sophia: Ack.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: smoke run complete scheduled time pending.
rachel: Great. We'll reconvene Mon for a dry-run readout.
